Privacy Policy

Effective October 16, 2026

Information you choose to share

When you contact Petty Tech Solutions, you may provide your name, phone number, email, service needs and a description of your issue. We use this information to respond, discuss services and coordinate requested support.

Contact requests

If online requests are enabled, the form sends the information you enter to our form-processing provider so we can receive and respond to it. If the form is unavailable, you can call or email us directly. Please do not send passwords, payment details or other sensitive information through the form or email.

Website operation

This website does not include advertising trackers or analytics scripts. Our hosting and communication providers may process technical information, such as IP addresses and request logs, to operate and protect their services.

Use and sharing

We do not sell contact-request information. Service providers that host this website, process requests or deliver email may process information as needed for those tasks. Information may also be disclosed when legally required.

Retention and choices

We retain contact information as needed to respond to requests, provide services and meet applicable obligations. Contact us to ask about correcting or deleting information you have provided.
